narrationTexts: I'll start by finding the remaining usages.
Now the mechanical rewrite across the 12 in-repo files:
finalText:
Migration finished. 36 call sites across 12 files:

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| accounts | `repo/session.js`, `service/teamService.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js` |
| billing | `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js` |
| orders | `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js` |
| catalog | `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js` |
| support | `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js` |
| analytics | `repo/cohort.js` |

Each `db.query(sql, params)` became `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the style of the already-migrated files (e.g. `packages/accounts/src/repo/user.js`). All files pass `node --check`.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** still calls `db.query`. Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local edits silently lost. Since `lib/db.js` says the driver's next major drops `query`, this needs a real fix — upgrading the vendored lib, or wrapping the handle passed to it — not an edit in place. Your call which; I can do the wrapper if you want.
- **`cache.query('...')`** in the `cachedX` helpers is `lib/cache.js`, a different object with a single-key signature — not part of this migration.
